body.name: \(\widehat Q_{\mathrm{HO}}\)
body.construction: Using sample splitting, a compactly supported boundary wavelet basis on \(\mathcal Y\), and a known-design covariate projection basis on \(\mathcal X\), estimate all retained outcome coefficients by finite-order projection-kernel propensity and outcome bias corrections; choose every resolution and correction order from \(n,d,m,\alpha,\beta,s,L\); form the resulting finite signed series with unit constant coefficient; quantize it on a finite refining outcome grid; minimize its finite Kantorovich--Rubinstein distance over the probability simplex with deterministic tie-breaking; return the minimizing atomic law and sample from its masses categorically.
